text: Recruit Holdings Co., Ltd., whose group companies include Indeed and Glassdoor, is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Section (code 6098). Per its own investor relations disclosure, its main shareholders as of 31 March 2026 are trust-bank nominees The Master Trust Bank of Japan (18.81%) and Custody Bank of Japan (7.17%), and State Street Bank and Trust Company (3.24%); no state or sovereign-fund owner is identified.
